# Settings reference

Document version 1.0 · 25 October 2026 · Applies to release v2.0.0

<!-- Generated by `npm run docs` from backend/platform/manifest.js. Do not edit by hand; `npm run check` fails when this file is out of date. -->

Every setting an administrator can change in the admin console, grouped as the console groups them (**Settings** in the menu). Settings exist only when the platform is switched on. Each one is enforced on the server, not only hidden on screen: an agent cannot get round a switched-off feature by changing their browser.

How changes reach agents: a saved change is sent to every open call panel at once. A call already in progress keeps the settings it started with; the change applies from the next call. Nothing changes until **Save changes** is pressed. How to use the console: [admin guide](admin-guide.md).

The **Key** is the setting's permanent name. It appears in the change history and never changes once released.

## Calling

| Setting | Key | Default | What it does | Enforced |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Agents can place calls | `connect.outbound` | On | Agents can dial from the call panel and use click-to-call. When off, the call panel hides the dial box and the server refuses any dial request. | server refuses the DIAL request |
| Agent chooses the queue | `connect.queueSelect` | On | Agents can pick which outbound queue a call goes out on. When off, outbound calls use the agent's standard outbound queue. _Has no effect while "Agents can place calls" is off._ | server drops a queue chosen by the agent |
| Open the contact when a call comes in | `connect.screenPop` | On | When a call rings, the matching contact opens in GoHighLevel. When off, the contact is not looked up or opened when a call rings. | server contact lookup |
| Hold and resume<br>_Controls during a call_ | `connect.hold` | On | The Hold and Resume buttons during a call. When off, the server refuses both hold and resume. | server refuses the HOLD request |
| Keypad (send digits)<br>_Controls during a call_ | `connect.keypad` | On | The Keypad button during a call, for sending digits (for example to an automated menu). | server refuses the DTMF request |
| Mute<br>_Controls during a call_ | `connect.mute` | On | The Mute button during a call. | server refuses the MUTE request |
| Transfer<br>_Controls during a call_ | `connect.transfer` | Off | Call transfer. Not available in this release; the switch is shown as Planned and cannot be turned on. _Planned._ | Not enforced (not available in this release) |
| Record missed calls | `crm.missedTask` | On | A call nobody answered still leaves a note and a call entry on the contact. When off, missed calls leave nothing in GoHighLevel. | server call-record writer |

## Wrap-up

| Setting | Key | Default | What it does | Enforced |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Wrap-up after calls | `connect.wrapEnabled` | On | After a call the agent gets a wrap-up step (disposition and note) before the call is finished. When off, the call is logged straight away. | server checks the wrap-up; server call-record writer |
| A disposition is required | `connect.dispReq` | Off | The agent must choose a disposition before finishing wrap-up. The server refuses to finish the call without one. _Has no effect while "Wrap-up after calls" is off._ | server checks the wrap-up; server refuses the COMPLETE request |
| Agents can add a note | `connect.notesShow` | On | The notes box in wrap-up. _Has no effect while "Wrap-up after calls" is off._ | server checks the wrap-up |
| A note is required | `connect.notesReq` | Off | The agent must type a note before finishing wrap-up. _Has no effect while "Agents can add a note" is off._ | server checks the wrap-up |
| Dispositions for inbound calls<br>_Dispositions_ | `connect.dispIn` | Interested, Callback requested, Not interested, No answer, Wrong number, Other | The dispositions offered after an inbound call (up to 30 entries, each up to 40 characters). The server refuses a value that is not in the list. | server checks the wrap-up |
| Dispositions for outbound calls<br>_Dispositions_ | `connect.dispOut` | Interested, Callback requested, Not interested, No answer, Wrong number, Other | The dispositions offered after an outbound call (same limits as the inbound list). | server checks the wrap-up |

## Conversation logging

| Setting | Key | Default | What it does | Enforced |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Create the call entry in GoHighLevel | `crm.logCall` | On | Creates the native "Call completed" entry in the contact's conversation in GoHighLevel. | server call-record writer |
| Attach the recording to the call entry | `crm.pushRecording` | On | Adds the recording player to the "Call completed" entry. The recording plays only for someone signed in to Amazon Connect with permission to hear recordings. _Has no effect while "Create the call entry in GoHighLevel" is off. Needs the GoHighLevel call entry capability (a marketplace app with a conversation provider)._ | server call-record writer |
| Post the call transcript | `crm.pushTranscript` | On | Posts the call transcript as one internal comment on the contact after the call. Independent of the live transcript switch. | server AI summary job |
| Write a note on the contact | `crm.noteOn` | On | Writes a note on the contact with the call details after each call. | server call-record writer |
| Include the AI summary in the note | `crm.noteSummary` | On | Adds the AI call summary to that note. _Has no effect while "Write a note on the contact" is off._ | server call-record writer; server AI summary job |
| Include the recording link in the note | `crm.noteRecUrl` | On | Adds the Amazon Connect recording link to that note. _Has no effect while "Write a note on the contact" is off._ | server call-record writer |
| Include the disposition in the note | `crm.noteDisp` | On | Adds the disposition to that note. The agent's own wrap-up note is always included. _Has no effect while "Write a note on the contact" is off._ | server call-record writer |

## AI assist

| Setting | Key | Default | What it does | Enforced |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Live suggestions (Amazon Q) | `connect.liveAssist` | On | Amazon Q suggestions and the Ask Q box on the Assist tab during calls. When off, the Assist tab is hidden. | server stops the live feed |
| Live transcript | `connect.liveTranscript` | On | The live transcript and caller sentiment on the Transcript tab during calls. When off, the Transcript tab is hidden. | server stops the live feed |
| AI call summary | `connect.aiSummary` | On | Requests an AI call summary from Amazon Connect after each answered call and saves it to the contact. When off, the Summary tab is hidden. | server AI summary job |
| Suggest a disposition | `connect.autoDisp` | Off | Suggesting a disposition with AI. Not available in this release; shown as Planned and cannot be turned on. _Planned._ | Not enforced (not available in this release) |

## Advanced

| Setting | Key | Default | What it does | Enforced |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Connector switched on | `platform.enabled` | On | The master switch. When off, every call panel disappears within about a minute, GoHighLevel's own dialler works again, and no new softphone sign-in is accepted. Calls already in progress finish and are still logged. | server sign-in and status API |
| Starting view of the call panel | `platform.panelMode` | full | How the call panel first appears: full (calls, assist, transcript and summary tabs) or compact (calls only). Each agent can still switch, and their own choice is remembered in their browser. | server sends it as the call panel's starting value |
| Refresh the contact page after a call is saved | `platform.autoRefresh` | On | After a call is saved, the contact page refreshes by itself so the new note shows, but only when it is safe (no call in progress, nothing being typed). Each agent can turn this off in the panel. | server sends it as the call panel's starting value |
| Create a contact for unknown callers | `crm.unknownCaller` | On | When a number has no contact, one is created when the call rings or is dialled, named "Unknown caller" with the number. Withheld numbers are never created. | server contact creation |

29 settings in total.
